description: This file defines a React component named `DataTable` that renders a customizable data table with support for custom cell rendering, actions, tooltips, and handling empty data states. It utilizes components from the '@tremor/react' library and 'antd' tooltip for display enhancements.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Helper function that renders individual cell content based on column configuration and cell value, including custom cell renderers and default rendering logic.
